claim: With m2 fixed at 0.5 on data_seed 1, the N=64 seed-23 24000-step run ends with force R2 0.84445 at layer 1. Layer 1 is also its best-margin layer, so this is a same-layer comparison. Force control is 0.63224, margin 0.212. The gap to the same-layer 24000-step N=128 seed-23 value (0.81915, run-20261015-225826-a2d5) is 0.025. That falls in the pre-registered inconclusive band (0.02, 0.04): the prediction needed >= 0.859, and the false case was <= 0.839. The horizon check passes: at step 12000, layer-1 control plus margin is about 0.632 + 0.203 = 0.835, within 0.012 of the 12000-step reference run-20261014-074634-b5ab (0.8467). accel_step reaches R2 0.952 at layer 3 vs control 0.769. Its headroom-normalised margin is 0.79, inside the predicted [0.60, 0.85], against 0.58 for force.
confidence_note: This is a single seed on a single dataset. The run completed all 24000 steps. The 0.025 gap sits 0.005 above the 'converges' bound and 0.015 below the 'ceiling' bound, so the verdict depends on noise at about the level of the force control_spread (0.028). N=64 force has levelled off at about 0.845 whatever the horizon: 0.8467 at the end of the 12000-step run and 0.8445 at the end of this one. So the seed-23 gap shrinking from about 0.032 at 12000 steps to 0.025 at 24000 comes entirely from N=128's late gain (+0.008), not from any change on the N=64 side. Inside this run, force was flat from step 3000 to step 12000 (0.831-0.835) and gained about 0.013 only in the second half, which fits a low-lr-tail effect. At matched val_mse_ratio the comparison could shift further, because N=64 reaches 0.0009, far below N=128. The verdict would move to 'refuted' if N=128 seed 23 trained longer (or read at matched loss) closes to within 0.02 of 0.845. It would move to 'supported' only if N=128 levels off at or below 0.805. Seed 22 on data_seed 0 (exp-20261016-004348-f687) is still running and will show whether the large-gap seed behaves differently.
